# Source:unit

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Return the source unit (and modify it on Vars and Sensors)

```lua
local unit = source:unit([unit])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `unit` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns

unit (integer)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
source1 = system.getSource("ALT")
print(source:unit()))
source:unit(UNIT_FOOT)
print(source:unit()))
```
